title: Integrating Segmented Cell Imaging and Molecular Networks for Drug-Specific Analysis in CM4AI

contributions.purpose: 提出对象级(单细胞)形态-PPI 嵌入管线
contributions.mechanism: LLM 引导分割→ViT 单细胞特征→Node2Vec PPI 嵌入→MUSE 对比共嵌入→Ward 层次聚类
contributions.evaluation: 与基线 CellMaps 层次高度一致:Untreated 97.9%、Paclitaxel 96.9%、Vorinostat 95.9% 蛋白重叠(12853 张 MDA-MB-468 图像)
contributions.domain: 生物医学多模态 AI/细胞图谱
contributions.source_quote: Across all conditions, the modified pipeline maintained >95% concordance with baseline hierarchies.

contributions.purpose: 提出可审计的半自动 agent 编排工作流
contributions.mechanism: 分割经交互式 LLM agent 桥接 HPC 执行,其余阶段人机协作生成/执行代码并记录 prompt/seed/checkpoint
contributions.evaluation: 定性:7 阶段人-AI 分工表(分割 95%AI 代码/70% agent 执行);运行 1 个月,2×P100
contributions.source_quote: segmentation is executed via an interactive agent bridged to HPC, and embedding/integration/hierarchy steps proceed through audited, human-in-the-loop code generation and execution.

contributions.purpose: 以本体验证捕捉药物特异网络重构
contributions.mechanism: 对 Paclitaxel/Vorinostat 修饰网络做 GO/KEGG 富集
contributions.evaluation: 定性:Vorinostat 富集染色质重塑/剪接体,Paclitaxel 富集微管相关/长时程增强,共享脂肪酸代谢
contributions.source_quote: Gene Ontology analyses recover drug-consistent pathways (e.g., chromatin regulation for Vorinostat; microtubule-associated processes for Paclitaxel)

self_declared_provenance.quote: it refines rather than replaces the original organization

While CM4AI demonstrated the promise of multimodal integration, it primarily operated on whole-image embeddings... Treating entire fields of view as single units forced the model to allocate capacity to irrelevant pixels

notes: 非实证类适配问题:核心卖点"提升信噪比/下游预测准确率"从未量化——唯一定量指标是与基线的>95% 一致性(concordance,衡量的是"没变"而非"变好"),"improved predictive accuracy"无任何精度数字支撑。质量红旗:分割无 ground truth,评估仅靠视觉检查(自述);无误差棒/显著性检验(checklist Q7 自答 No);富集分析纯相关。trade-off:agentic 工作流引入操作风险(agent 误点按钮需人工接管)。checklist:假设[B]、写作[B]、分析约 90% AI;自曝需人工纠正幻觉引用。GPT-5/Gemini co-pilot;匿名 4open.science 仓库。
